# Caps Lock as the layout key, at a command prompt whose prompt is ">" (opened
# as for console.txt). Nothing is entered: the line is cleared with Esc at the end.
caps-lock:on
layout:en
wait:800
type:ghbdtn
key:capslock
type:\sghbdtn
contains:>ghbdtn привет
key:capslock
type:\sok
contains:>ghbdtn привет ok
key:esc
